close_reason: Fixed in commit d0a0bd4. metadata_set's doc-comment now explicitly describes the create-map shape: caller-chosen creation id keys (RFC 8620 §3.7 #-prefixed result reference syntax) and partial Metadata values per draft §3.1, with the three @type variant citations (§2.1.1 Annotation, §2.1.2 ImapMetadata, §2.1.3 WebDavMetadata). Also notes that wire-shape mismatches are caught server-side as invalidArguments.
description:
src/methods/metadata.rs:130-156 — metadata_set's 'create: Option<serde_json::Value>' parameter is documented as:

    Pass create, update, and/or destroy as needed. All three are
    optional; pass None to omit any operation from the request.

The doc-comment does not tell the caller:
- What JSON shape 'create' must take. The wire shape per RFC 8620 §5.3 is { creation_key → Metadata_create_object }, but the signature shows serde_json::Value — a caller could pass an array, a primitive, anything. The server will return invalidArguments, but only after a network round-trip.
- Which spec section defines the create-record schema (draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-01 §3.1, specifically the @type variants Annotation, ImapMetadata, WebDavMetadata).
- That the creation_key string is referenced from later result references (RFC 8620 §3.7 — '#creation_key' syntax).
- That the @type field is mandatory on each create-record (since Metadata is an #[serde(tag = '@type')] enum in jmap-metadata-types).

Compare to the doc-comment on 'update' in the same function (line 119-123) which DOES document the PatchObject contract.

A caller reading the function signature alone cannot construct a valid 'create' value without going to the spec. The doc-comment is duty-bound to either:
(a) Type the parameter as Option<HashMap<String, MetadataCreate>> (this is wzq9.6's territory).
(b) If (a) is intentionally deferred, document the wire shape and cite the spec section.

Recommendation: (b) as a stopgap now (cheap doc fix, additive), and pursue (a) under wzq9.6. The combination gives callers a path to construct a valid request without contract surprises.

Workspace-wide: canonical email_set in mail-client has the same docs gap. Propagate.
title: metadata_set: 'create' arg has no schema hint in doc-comment
